37
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, December 2, 2014/Agrahayana 11, 1936 (Saka)
(Ministries : Ayurveda, Yoga & Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha and Homoeopathy
(AYUSH); Civil Aviation; Corporate Affairs; Defence; Finance; Health and
Family Welfare; Information and Broadcasting; Minority Affairs)
Total number of questions — 20
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Grounding of pilots by DGCA
*121. SHRI AHMED PA TEL: Will the
Minister of CIVIL A VIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the Directorate General of
Civil Aviation (DGCA) has recently
grounded a large number of pilots of
domestic airlines in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof, airline-wise;
and
(c) the reasons for grounding these
pilots?
Inclusion of study on cancer in MBBS
curriculum
†*122. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that every year
five lakh people die of cancer in the country;
(b) whether it is also a fact that lives of
80 per cent of the patients can be saved if it
is diagnosed at an early stage;
(c) whether it is also a fact that nothing
is taught about cancer in MBBS curriculum;
and
(d) if so, whether Government would
include study on cancer in MBBS
curriculum in the national interest and, if
so, by when?
Malnourishment and anaemia in
children and women
*123. SHRI DIGVIJAYA SINGH: Will
the Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) the details of action Government has
taken on the suggestions in my letter number
4672 dated 19 August, 2014 wherein it was
suggested that the Ministry should target
the severely malnourished or anaemic
children and women marking all the
geographical areas and the affected social
groups so that the project can be taken up
in a more focussed and targeted manner;
and
(b) whether the Ministry would take
up the matter with the Planning
Commission to ensure that the list of
family below poverty line must also have

38
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
incidence of anaemia and malnourishment
as one of the indicators, as incidence of
anaemia and malnourishment is the first
sign of poverty?
Monitoring of CSR activities
*124. SHRI KALPATARU DAS: Will
the Minister of CORPORATE AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is considering
to have a Regulatory and Monitoring
Authority to regulate and monitor
Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR)
activities by different Public Sector
Undertakings (PSUs)/Companies; and
(b) if not, whether Government will
consider to have one such authority?
Drug resistant malaria mosquitoes
*125. SHRI MD. NADIMUL
HAQUE: Will the Minister of HEALTH
AND FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that malaria
mosquitoes in some districts of West Bengal
have been found to be drug resistant, if so,
the details thereof;
(b) whether any specific study has been
conducted by the Ministry in this regard,
if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the details of steps that have been
taken by Government in this regard?
Money collected by Ponzi companies
in West Bengal
*126. SHRI RITABRATA BANERJEE:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that 136 Ponzi
companies apart from Saradha have
collected a huge amount of money from the
people of West Bengal;
(b) if so, the amount of the money
collected, and the names of the companies;
and
(c) the action initiated against these
companies?
Deaths at sterilization camp in
Bilaspur
*127. SHRI D. KUPENDRA REDDY:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Central Government
took notice of the illegal sterilization camp
held at Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh recently and
the subsequent illness and deaths of women
there due to botched mass and forced
sterilisation;
(b) if so, the details thereof and whether
any probe has been ordered by
Government;
(c) if so, the details thereof and, if not,
the reasons therefor; and
(d) the steps taken or being taken by
the Central Government to curb such illegal
sterilization camps?
Loans to minorities
†*128. SHRI ASHK ALI TAK: Will
the Minister of MINORITY AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) the names of States and amount
approved by Government for granting loans
to minority communities during the years
2012-13 and 2013-14; and
(b) the number of persons benefited and
the details thereof, State-wise?

39
Testing of food items/products by
FSSAI

Minister of HEALTH AND  FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Food Safety and
Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) has
any role to check the authenticity about
the tall claims of the Indian and foreign
food companies about the quality of the
food items/products especially about the
body building food supplements advertised
in Indian TV channels/newspapers;
(b) if so, whether such products, Indian
and foreign, are tested in laboratories under
FSSAI;
(c

RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, December 2, 2014/Agrahayana 11, 1936 (Saka)
————
(Ministries :  Ayurveda, Yoga & Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha and Homoeopathy
(AYUSH); Civil Aviation; Corporate Affairs; Defence; Finance; Health and
Family Welfare; Information and Broadcasting; Minority Affairs)
Total number of questions — 155
Central Ayurveda University
931. SHRI P. RAJEEVE: Will the
Minister of AYURVEDA, YOGA &
NATUROPATHY , UNANI, SIDDHA
AND HOMOEOPATHY be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the Ministry has any plans
to establish Central Ayurveda University;
and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Development of Unani system of
medicines
932. SHRIMATI RAJANI PATIL:
Will the Minister of AYURVEDA, YOGA
& NATUROPATHY, UNANI, SIDDHA
AND HOMOEOPATHY be pleased to
state:
(a) the details of funds allocated for
Allopathy, Homoeopathy, Ayurveda and
Unani systems of medicine during the last
two years and the current year;
(b) how much of these funds were
utilized in each year, year-wise; and
(c) the steps being taken to develop
Unani system of medicines and to increase
allocation for the same?
New institutes for AYUSH
933. SHRI KALPATARU DAS: Will
the Minister of AYURVEDA, YOGA &
NATUROPATHY , UNANI, SIDDHA
AND HOMOEOPATHY be pleased to
state the names of the national level
institutes functioning or under pipeline on
Ayurveda, Yoga and Naturopathy, Unani,
Siddha and Homoeopathy (AYUSH) with
their function, institute-wise, State-wise,
and planning for opening of new Institutes
during the Twelfth Plan period?
Modernization of airports in
Telangana and Andhra Pradesh
934. SHRI GARIKAPATI MOHAN
RAO: Will the Minister of CIVIL
A VIATION be pleased to state:
(a) the status of development,
upgradation and modernization plan
undertaken for the airports in the country;
(b) the names of such airports selected
in the States of Telangana and Andhra
Pradesh; and
(c) the funds allocated and the time
frame fixed for the proposed development
of airports in Telangana and Andhra
Pradesh?

208
Greenfield airport at Ongole in
Andhra Pradesh
935. SHRI C.M. RAMESH: Will the
Minister of CIVIL A VIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether there is any proposal to set
up a greenfield airport at Ongole in
Prakasam District of Andhra Pradesh; and
(b) if so, the details of funds released so
far for the project, as of now?
Development of airports in Uttar
Pradesh
†936. SHRIMATI KANAK LA TA
SINGH: Will the Minister of CIVIL
A VIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that proposal for
setting up an airport at Zevar in Greater
Noida is being contemplated by the
Ministry;
(b) the number of places in Uttar
Pradesh where Government is serious about
establishing of airports;
(c) whether there is a lax approach in
setting up of the proposed international
airport in Kushinagar district keeping in
view the Buddhist tourism;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) by when the construction work of
the airport in Kushinagar is likely to be
started and the target by when the
international flights are to be operated from
there?
SC/STs Employees Welfare
Association
937. SHRI AMBETH RAJAN: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Scheduled Caste/Scheduled
Tribe Employees' Welfare Organisation or
Association have been established by the
Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs) under
the administrative control of the Ministry;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether bye-Laws/rules governing
the functioning of SC/ST Employees'
Association, if any existing, is duly
approved and regularly updated;
(d) whether any mechanism exists to
oversee their functioning; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Plastic free airports
938. SHRI ANIL MADHAV DA VE:
Will the Minister of CIVIL A VIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
make airports in India plastic free;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether there are such model
airports in the country; and
(d) if so, the names of such airport,
State-wise?
Requirement of pilots and aircraft
maintenance engineers
939. SHRI KALPATARU DAS: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) the total requirement of pilots,
aircraft maintenance engineers as on date
and for the next five years;
(b) how many Indian pilots/aircraft
maintenance engineers have been working,
at present;
(c) how many foreign nationals have
been given licences and are working in such
capacity in the country; and

to meet the present and future deficit of
such professionals?

to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
Directorate General of Civil Aviation
(DGCA) has issued directions to no frills
carriers to refund fare to passengers for the
flights delayed for hours;
